S7 class for prior distribution specifications

Source: R/S7-prior.R
MVBU_Prior.Rd

Represents prior distribution specifications in a dual-space (original vs. transformed cue space) framework, supporting flexible brms-style declarations across parameter classes.

Constructs a prior specification in the style of brms.

Usage

MVBU_Prior(
  declaration = character(),
  par_class = character(),
  category = character(),
  cue = character(),
  par = character(),
  cue_space = character()
)

parameter_prior(
  declaration,
  class = c("tau_0", "cor_0", "m_0", "weight", "weights", "lapse_rate", "lapse_bias",
    "category_prior", "kappa_0", "nu_0"),
  category = NULL,
  cue = NULL,
  par = NULL,
  cue_space = c("transformed", "original")
)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Prior'
c(..., recursive = FALSE)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Prior'
x[i, ...]

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Prior'
length(x)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Prior'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Prior'
as_tibble(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Prior'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

declaration

Character string or numeric scalar specifying the prior distribution (e.g., "cauchy(0, 5)", "lkj(1)", "normal(0, 1)", or numeric 5).

par_class

Character vector of parameter classes (e.g., "tau_0", "cor_0", "m_0", "weight", "lapse_rate", "lapse_bias", "category_prior", "kappa_0", "nu_0").

category

Character string specifying category name (default: "" or NULL for class-wide priors).

cue

Character string specifying cue name (default: "" or NULL for all cues).

par

Character string specifying an optional coefficient, cue, or category name (default: NULL for class-wide priors).

cue_space

Character string specifying whether the prior is formulated in transformed cue space ("transformed", the default) or original physical cue space ("original").

class

Character string specifying the parameter class. Supported classes include:

  • "tau_0": Scale / standard deviation for category covariance.

  • "cor_0": Correlation matrix / Cholesky factor L_omega.

  • "m_0": Category prior mean m_0.

  • "weight": Cue integration weights.

  • "lapse_rate": Lapse probability.

  • "lapse_bias": Lapse response distribution simplex.

  • "category_prior": Category prior probability simplex.

  • "kappa_0": Prior pseudocount for mean.

  • "nu_0": Prior pseudocount for covariance.

...

Additional arguments passed to print.

recursive

Logical (default: FALSE).

x

An MVBU_Prior object.

i

Indices specifying elements to extract.

row.names

Optional row names (default: NULL).

optional

Logical (default: FALSE).

Value

An object of class MVBU_Prior.

A single combined MVBU_Prior object.

A subsetted MVBU_Prior object.

An integer length.

A data.frame of prior specifications.

A tibble of prior specifications.

The object x, invisibly.

See also

fit_ideal_adaptor, fix_parameter

Examples

# Specify class-wide priors
p1 <- parameter_prior("cauchy(0, 5)", class = "tau_0")
p2 <- parameter_prior("lkj(1)", class = "cor_0")
p3 <- parameter_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "m_0")

# Combine priors into a list
c(p1, p2, p3)
#> MVBeliefUpdatr Prior Specifications:
#>   declaration class category   cue par   cue_space
#>  cauchy(0, 5) tau_0    (all) (all)     transformed
#>        lkj(1) cor_0    (all) (all)     transformed
#>  normal(0, 1)   m_0    (all) (all)     transformed
